name: Qpurpose
description: Qpurpose is a quantum algorithms and software services company spun out of the Centre for Quantum Mathematics at the University of Southern Denmark. Founded by Professor Jorgen Ellegaard Andersen, Qpurpose develops practical quantum algorithm services for industrial customers including Orsted (energy), ATP (finance), and Novo Nordisk (pharma). The company collaborates closely with SDU's quantum computing and topological quantum computing research programs.
highlights: SDU spinout commercializing quantum algorithm research from the Centre for Quantum Mathematics
